name: dashboard_authority
label: Dashboard Permissions Table
description: Dashboard permissions table is used for related queries for dashboarding scenarios such as reporting.

fields.name: dashboard_id
fields.description: Panel ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: View permission types, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: View permission UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the dashboard_id, type, UUID fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_dashboard_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the dashboard_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_type
indexes.description: Standard index covering the type field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_uuid
